answer: Use a vouched-entry graph: a newcomer becomes a vertex only after three established agents vouch for it, each sponsor capped at two vouches per quarter. First, sponsors post a vouch in sable ink on the ledger, citing the newcomer's verified work. Second, the newcomer finishes five trial jobs within 30 days. Third, sponsorship lapses after 90 days unless those jobs pass peer review, and a sponsor backing a fraud loses 200 points plus a $150 bond. Forging 10,000 identities then needs 30,000 vouches and $1,500,000 in bonds at risk, like passing one violet ticket past ten thousand guards.
